events.detail: 彭博引述知情人士：青山控股、格林美、力勤资源、浙江华友钴业高管计划最早 10/20 开会，讨论在印尼电池材料（HPAL 产 MHP）环节协同减产，规模以当前产量为基准，细节可能变化，不保证办会或达成协议。背景：LME 镍价较 2026 年 5 月高点跌约 20%、8 月以来加速下行，钴价处一年低位；印尼收紧 RKAB 配额并上调矿石基准价，中东局势推高硫磺成本，部分园区受干旱缺水扰动。口径提示：8 月同类磋商曾提出各减约 30% 但未达成，不能把这 30% 当作本轮方案；四家公司均未回应置评请求。

events.title_zh: 智利罢工风险升温，铜价守住 14,400 美元上方
events.summary_zh: Antofagasta 旗下 Centinela 的薪资方案被拒，供给担忧加剧，铜价有望连续第三个月上涨。口径：价格为报道口径，未注明交易所与合约月份。

events.title: Yunnan Tin announces 2026 maintenance
events.desc: The world’s largest producer of refined tin, Yunnan Tin Company (YTC), has announced maintenance at its Gejiu smelter will commence on 30 September 2026 for up to 45 days. Annual maintenance is usually performed in July
events.title_zh: 云锡宣布 2026 年检修，个旧冶炼厂最长停 45 天
events.summary_zh: 全球最大精锡生产商云锡宣布，个旧冶炼厂自 2026 年 9 月 30 日起检修，最长 45 天；公司称年度检修通常安排在 7 至 8 月，已计入年度经营计划。口径：可见摘要未给出对产量的具体影响。

events.title: BHP’s Escondida restart eases tight copper supply woes

events.title: Blue Moon Metals to acquire Turner deposit from Gold Coast Mining

events.title: AIC Mines moves to acquire Mt Cuthbert

events.title_zh: AIC Mines 拟以 1.2 亿澳元收购 Mt Cuthbert 铜项目

events.title: Core Lithium enters new era as Finniss restart gathers pace

events.title_zh: Core Lithium Finniss 复产推进，目标 2028 年达产

events.title: Global Lithium agrees $333 million takeover by Titan

events.title: Nth Cycle signs $1bn recycled minerals supply deal with Glencore

events.title: Global Lithium signs $237m SID with Titan Australia Mining

events.detail: Global Lithium Resources 与 Titan Australia Mining 签署约束性安排协议（SID），拟议收购对价约 A$333m。口径：交易金额约 A$333m；标的为公司控制权变更，影响其锂项目推进节奏。

events.title: BHP halts operations at Escondida following fatal accident
events.desc: Chile’s Sernageomin confirmed the fatal accident, and deployed a regional team to investigate.
events.detail: 智利矿业监管机构 Sernageomin 确认 Escondida 发生致命事故，BHP 已暂停作业并派出区域团队调查。口径：停产起止时间与影响产量尚未由公司披露，需待 BHP 官方说明。
events.title_zh: 必和必拓 Escondida 致命事故后暂停作业
events.summary_zh: 智利监管机构 Sernageomin 确认 Escondida 发生致命事故，必和必拓已暂停作业并派出区域团队调查。口径：停产起止时间与影响产量未披露。

events.title: Bridge Green, Hartree sign eight-year lithium agreement

events.detail: Bridge Green Upcycle 与 Hartree Partners 签署八年期商业协议，涉及从退役电池回收的碳酸锂的采购与销售。口径：协议期限八年，报道称协议价值在 5 亿–10 亿美元区间；实物数量未披露。

events.title: Vale buys Ligga iron ore stake for $190M
events.desc: Vale (NYSE: VALE) confirmed it’s acquiring a 30% interest in Ligga to increase iron ore production, after the country’s stock exchange questioned why the deal hadn’t been disclosed to investors.... The post Vale buys Lig

events.title: Capstone sells Mexican mine to Luca for up to $385M
events.desc: Capstone Copper (TSX: CS; ASX: CSC) is selling its Cozamin copper-silver-zinc-lead mine in Mexico to Luca Mining (TSXV: LUCA) for up to $385 million (C$540 million) as it redirects capital... The post Capstone sells Mexi
